scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF peer route boundaries and downstream LibreCAD_3 policy.
Compare advertised version/direction support with route, entity, retention, writer, and semantic evidence limits.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review, local checkout revision audit, generated adapter probe, and plan/receipt update

localProbe.input: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF ModelDocViewStyle graph in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp

method.limitations: Upstream master pages are mutable and no peer executable was run. The generated object graph demonstrates the local typed-name omission but is not normative wire evidence; the representation rule must still be confirmed against ODA and/or a producer-authored graph before semantic claims change. Adjacent local peer clones are stale and are not treated as current behavioral evidence.

peerRouteBoundaries.observation: Current policy document describes opt-in read-only DWG import, a frozen ledger with 15 read claims (11 EXPERIMENTAL, 4 PENDING_NATIVE, none PROMOTED), and no write claims.
peerRouteBoundaries.evidenceCeiling: Downstream product policy and claim gate, not an independent codec or 3D/native acceptance result.

peerRouteBoundaries.observation: README discloses advanced-object read skips and version-qualified DWG writer limitations; class maturity labels do not encode complete field-level or native-writer evidence.
peerRouteBoundaries.evidenceCeiling: Optional pinned structural/semantic comparator only, with exact version, direction, build options, and skipped outcomes recorded.

peerRouteBoundaries.observation: Public compatibility table is direction-by-version and marks AC1021 DWG writing unsupported despite later writer rows.
peerRouteBoundaries.evidenceCeiling: Route denominator only, not per-entity completeness or native acceptance.

peerRouteBoundaries.observation: DXF-focused model/read-write implementation with selective import and XY projection; its drawing renderer does not render ACIS, and ACIS payload authoring requires an external library.
peerRouteBoundaries.evidenceCeiling: Pinned DXF syntax/field/carrier checks only, not a DWG reader or general solid-semantic oracle.

par138TypedNameGap.localResult: Generated dictionary graph carries names, but typed DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle callbacks receive empty DRW_TableEntry::name.
par138TypedNameGap.sourceEvidence: Autodesk exposes Name on DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle; local style object parsing dispatches before any order-independent dictionary-to-style name resolution.
par138TypedNameGap.classification: Confirmed local typed-property omission under existing PAR-138; no new top-level finding ID.
par138TypedNameGap.nextStep: Resolve from ODA plus an independent/producer style graph, then implement bounded order-independent owner-checked dictionary-key association and generated reorder/ambiguity controls.
